subject.title: feat(ui): add message preview to session list

question: Should the narrow Control UI Sessions-list preview land as its own UX change, or be folded into broader Sessions overview work?
rationale: The backend and TUI already support last-message previews, but the visible Control UI list design overlaps with broader open sessions overview, title, and organization work, so automation should not choose the product scope alone.

options.title: Land a narrow preview
options.body: Sponsor a port of this PR or a replacement PR that reuses `includeLastMessage` and renders a compact preview in the current Sessions table.

options.title: Fold into broader Sessions overview
options.body: Keep the paired feature issue linked to the broader sessions design and close or replace this branch after naming that canonical direction.

options.title: Do not add table previews now
options.body: Leave the Sessions table as a technical management view and close the paired implementation with a stated UX rationale.

recommendation.title: Land a narrow preview
recommendation.body: Sponsor a port of this PR or a replacement PR that reuses `includeLastMessage` and renders a compact preview in the current Sessions table.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Sessions UI and cross-platform session-management commits make this the clearest routing candidate for the Control UI product choice.
